players.product: Siyuan (MLU) cloud AI chips and accelerator cards, AI servers and intelligent computing cluster systems for large-model training and inference

quarterly_data.signal: The company (H1 2026 results briefing) itemised its inventory at June 30, 2026: raw materials book value RMB 5,278,354,947.15, materials in outsourced processing RMB 2,418,438,933.49, finished goods RMB 85,384,857.95 and goods shipped (not yet accepted) RMB 465,330,745.41; purchasing plans are set from customer orders and its forecast of future market demand, and inventory equals 45.32% of total assets. Chairman Chen Tianshi said lower operating cash flow reflected higher purchases and tax payments, higher prepayments were prepaid purchases, contract liabilities rose on more advance payments received, and with domestic semiconductor raw-material prices rising overall the company will respond through strategic stocking; he said a changed market could raise inventory write-down risk.
